new_value: {"notes":"Post-fix review: FragmentSender lock serializes sender methods, but manager receipt acceptance/touch and semantic status/attempt/finish are still separate security-lock transactions. Rotation can interleave after accept_ack/touch and before finish/return, allowing an old-key retransmission after rekey or a consumed ACK followed by finish failure. Make ACK/timeout semantic transition and manager record mutation one transaction with lock ordering tests."}
